title: Implicit Priors Editing in Stable Diffusion via Targeted Token Adjustment
reasoning: The paper proposes a method for editing implicit priors in Stable Diffusion by adjusting word token embeddings. While it specifically includes a section on mitigating gender bias (a fairness issue) and contains an 'Ethical Considerations & Safety' section, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
